parameters.note: Number 3 Lake is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide regulation for inland lakes, reservoirs, and ponds in §5.85(a)(1).

candidates.authorityName: U.S. Forest Service — Eldorado National Forest

parameters.description: Number 3 Lake lies inside Desolation Wilderness (Eldorado National Forest), where a wilderness permit is required to enter: overnight permits are required year-round, and day users must carry a free day-use permit (self-issue at most major trailheads in summer; day-use permits are not required in winter, roughly October to March).

raw.day_use_permit: free; self-issue at most major trailheads in summer; not required in winter (roughly October to March)

candidates.summary: Desolation Wilderness entry permit required: overnight permits year-round; free self-issue day-use permit in summer

schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Number 3 Lake (Region 2, El Dorado Co.) for fingerling-size Golden Trout under the Put and Grow program, with a stated release month range of August-September. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
